provenance.win_sd: 10th percentile of the 8 px windows of the lowest of 11 mown-grass crops (0.0121), rounded down; the stills pass it by construction (STILL_FLOOR_SELFCHECK)
provenance.win_foot_m: 8 px x ~0.15 m/px = ~1.2 m: the stills' finest resolved window, so the texture is compared at the SAME ground footprint
provenance.flat_sd: half of win_sd's source (0.0121/2): the Game view's 8 px window covers ~0.05-0.4 m, window sd ~ footprint^0.4 in the stills' own w8/w16/w32 series
provenance.flat_max: the Unity probe's PROBE_GROUND_TEXTURED cap (15 %); the stills' own clean crops have <= 5 % flat windows
